stops.name: Tomasee lake
stops.quote: From the Oberalppass, a steep climb leads to the source of the Rhine at the Tomasee lake.
stops.english: From the Oberalppass, a steep climb leads to the source of the Rhine at the Tomasee lake.

stops.name: Val Maighels
stops.quote: After hiking through the wetlands of Val Maighels you start the climb to the Maighelspass and the idyllic Portgerensee lake.
stops.english: After hiking through the wetlands of Val Maighels you start the climb to the Maighelspass and the idyllic Portgerensee lake.

stops.name: Portgerensee lake
stops.quote: After hiking through the wetlands of Val Maighels you start the climb to the Maighelspass and the idyllic Portgerensee lake.
stops.english: After hiking through the wetlands of Val Maighels you start the climb to the Maighelspass and the idyllic Portgerensee lake.

stops.name: Maighels Hut
stops.quote: The circular bike route from Sedrun to the Maighels Hut first leads straight to the source of the Rhine before crossing the Oberalp Pass and returning to Sedrun.
stops.english: The circular bike route from Sedrun to the Maighels Hut first leads straight to the source of the Rhine before crossing the Oberalp Pass and returning to Sedrun.

stops.name: Piz Calmot mountain inn
stops.quote: The Piz Calmot mountain inn is located at the top of the Oberalp Pass at 2,048 meters above sea level, in the immediate vicinity of the source of the Rhine.
stops.english: The Piz Calmot mountain inn is located at the top of the Oberalp Pass at 2,048 meters above sea level, in the immediate vicinity of the source of the Rhine.

stops.name: Rhine Gorge
stops.quote: Visit Chur, Disentis, and Andermatt, and travel through the Rhine Gorge via the Oberalp Pass.
stops.english: Visit Chur, Disentis, and Andermatt, and travel through the Rhine Gorge via the Oberalp Pass.

stops.name: Pazolastock
stops.quote: The hut is reached from the Oberalp Pass via Pazolastock or from Maighels in two to three hours.
stops.english: The hut is reached from the Oberalp Pass via Pazolastock or from Maighels in two to three hours.

stops.name: Piz Badus
stops.quote: This four-hour ski tour on the Gotthard massif takes you up 2,928-metre Piz Badus before descending more than 1,300 metres via the Maighelshütte to Tschamut.
stops.english: This four-hour ski tour on the Gotthard massif takes you up 2,928-metre Piz Badus before descending more than 1,300 metres via the Maighelshütte to Tschamut.

stops.name: Cuolm Val
stops.quote: But even the more demanding skiers enjoy the most beautiful piste in the area – the pleasantly wide Sedrun Ride from Cuolm Val to Dieni.
stops.english: But even the more demanding skiers enjoy the most beautiful piste in the area – the pleasantly wide Sedrun Ride from Cuolm Val to Dieni.

stops.name: Dieni
stops.quote: But even the more demanding skiers enjoy the most beautiful piste in the area – the pleasantly wide Sedrun Ride from Cuolm Val to Dieni.
stops.english: But even the more demanding skiers enjoy the most beautiful piste in the area – the pleasantly wide Sedrun Ride from Cuolm Val to Dieni.
